scripts.lint: eslint scripts directus && pnpm --filter frontend-v2 lint
scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown .prettierrc.json README.md package.json eslint.config.js deploy directus frontend-v2 scripts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown .prettierrc.json README.md package.json eslint.config.js deploy directus frontend-v2 scripts
scripts.directus:schema:diff: docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/compose.yaml -f deploy/compose.dev.yaml exec -T directus node cli.js schema apply --dry-run --yes /directus/project/schema.yaml
scripts.directus:schema:apply: docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/compose.yaml -f deploy/compose.dev.yaml exec -T directus node cli.js schema apply --yes /directus/project/schema.yaml && docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/compose.yaml -f deploy/compose.dev.yaml exec -T postgres sh -c 'psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"' < directus/database.sql
scripts.directus:schema:dump: docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/compose.yaml -f deploy/compose.dev.yaml exec -T directus node cli.js schema snapshot --yes /directus/project/schema.yaml && docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/compose.yaml -f deploy/compose.dev.yaml exec -T postgres sh -c 'pg_dump -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" --clean --if-exists --no-owner --no-privileges --schema=public' > directus/database.sql
